limitations: All 41 initial outcomes and all 16 original physical pages were reviewed. No error candidate proposed. Forecasts and educational frameworks were not promoted to factual findings.

Long research sources are evidence only. Targeted extents: Buntins original pp. 1, 7–11; 2014 Materialkompass pp. 4–6,16; BMK pp. 1–3,6–7; US experience paper abstract/methods; ECB abstract and physical pp. 4–7; SAFE physical pp. 4–6,16–18; NBER 17110 physical pp. 1–2,5–6,15–16; PISA 126 physical pp. 2–4.

Current retrievals establish dated publication contents, not historic web snapshots. Failed or empty requests are not usable evidence. Original 2023 Buntins version and 2009/2014 experience working versions are distinguished from exact cited versions.
Financial models and expected welfare gains are not realised facts. No intent inference and no source-access gap treated as error.
